== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-r5d4-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour) (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same game text. The black strip under the text box now carries only the white italic “E”, without the title.

The earlier slip and the new slip, both as cut from their sheets at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
